lines.text: After 13 years, GTA 6 is finally out.
And it made about one point eight four billion dollars, by release day.
GTA 5 needed three days, just to reach one billion.
Avengers Endgame opened at about one point two billion worldwide.
GTA 6 beat that, before most people even played it.
So many copies were pre-ordered, sales could slow faster from here.
That's what Take-Two investors are watching now.
